facts.text: The programme will also include bilateral meetings with senior Egyptian Ministers, interactions with leading business representatives and meetings with the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank), the Egyptian Junior Businessmen Association and the Egypt–India Startups Forum.

The 7th Session of the India–Egypt Joint Trade Committee (JTC) will be co-chaired by Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal and Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt H.E.
Bilateral merchandise trade during April–September 2026 stood at USD 5.04 billion, registering a growth of 64 per cent over the corresponding period of the previous year.
India's exports to Egypt during FY 2025–26 amounted to USD 3.87 billion, while imports from Egypt stood at USD 2.60 billion.
